Aashvi Goan Restaurant · Cola Beach, Canacona · ★ 5.0 (21 reviews)

Fire-fried.
Hand-spiced.
Coastal at heart.

A menu built around the charred edge, the rava crunch, and the last-minute fistful of coriander — the way it's always been done on the coast.

01 — On the Tawa

Fry & Starters

Everything here is fried to order, dusted in-house spice, and finished with raw onion and lime on the side.

Mushroom Masala Fry

Button mushrooms tossed in a dry turmeric-chilli masala, finished with fresh coriander.

Vegetarian

Chicken 65

Deep-fried chicken in a fiery red marinade, tempered with curry leaf and served with onion and lemon.

Chicken

Hariyali Chicken Fry

Chicken shallow-fried in a coriander-mint green masala, slit chillies folded through at the end.

Chicken

Rava Fish Fry

Fish fillet marinated in red masala, coated in coarse semolina and pan-fried until the crust shatters.

Fish

Surmai Rava Fry

Kingfish steaks in the same coarse rava crust, served with a raw carrot and cabbage slaw.

Fish

Butter Garlic Prawns

Prawns fried hard and fast, finished with crisp onion shreds and a scatter of coriander.

Prawn
02 — Slow & Simmered

Curry Pot

Onion-tomato base curries, simmered low and topped with a heavy hand of fresh herbs.

Tawa Pomfret

Whole pomfret, slit and marinated, seared on the tawa and finished with sea salt flakes and lime.

Fish

Calamari Masala

Squid rings simmered in a coconut-tomato masala, whole green chillies left in for the aroma.

Squid

Home-Style Curry

A slow-cooked masala gravy, deep and dark from roasted onion, piled high with coriander.

Chef's Pot
Tawa Fried to order, not held under a lamp
Rava Coarse semolina crust on every fish fillet
Fresh Coriander and lime finished table-side
03 — Between Meals

Quick Bites

Lighter plates for the in-between hours.

Bombay Club Toastie

Buttered white bread, toasted, packed with a spiced egg-and-vegetable filling and fresh coriander.

Vegetarian

Masala Cheese Maggi

Instant noodles cooked down with onion, tomato and peas, finished with a blanket of melted cheese.

Vegetarian
